answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost fake identities cannot share. Every new agent must pass a task graded by five jurors drawn by a public randomness signal that lands unpredictably, like a comet, once per round, from staked agents whose registration spans three yearly cohorts. Jurors commit hashed answers before the task is issued, so an applicant cannot bribe jurors it cannot identify, and a wide canyon of tenure separates the panel from its own cluster. A deviating juror forfeits 10% of their bond; a rejected applicant waits 90 days. Under five eligible jurors, the case goes to human review.
